kidney_cox_gamma_efron.call: coxph(Surv(time, status) ~ age + female + frailty(id, dist = 'gamma', theta = theta, sparse = FALSE), ties = 'efron') against coxph(Surv(time, status) ~ age + female)

settings.loglik: R's I-likelihood, history[[1]]$c.loglik, at the theta maximising it

kidney_cox_gamma_breslow.call: coxph(Surv(time, status) ~ age + female + frailty(id, dist = 'gamma', theta = theta, sparse = FALSE), ties = 'breslow') against coxph(Surv(time, status) ~ age + female)

settings.loglik: R's I-likelihood, history[[1]]$c.loglik, at the theta maximising it

kidney_cox_gamma_no_frailty.call: coxph(Surv(time, status) ~ age + female + I(disease == 'PKD') + frailty(id, dist = 'gamma')) against the same without frailty

kidney_lognormal_weibull.call: glmer(status ~ <terms> + (1 | id) + offset(log(stop^shape - start^shape)), family = poisson, nAGQ = 25), profiled over shape; null survreg(Surv(time, status) ~ age + female, dist = 'weibull')

settings.model: Weibull PH baseline, log-normal frailty u = exp(w), w ~ N(0, theta)
settings.step: the split at tau with `late` under both models; step_z = 2 (loglik with late:z - loglik with late)
settings.square_age: 2 (loglik with I((age / 10)^2) - loglik without): the model with I(age^2), scaled (unscaled, glmer stops 0.004 short)

kidney_lognormal_exponential.call: glmer(status ~ age + female + (1 | id) + offset(log(time)), family = poisson, nAGQ = 25); null survreg(..., dist = 'exponential')

kidney_gamma_weibull.call: optim() of the closed-form gamma-frailty Weibull PH marginal likelihood (see the comment above gamma_nll); null survreg(Surv(time, status) ~ age + female, dist = 'weibull')

settings.model: Weibull PH baseline, gamma frailty of mean 1, variance theta
settings.step: the split at tau with `late` under both models; step_z = 2 (loglik with late:z - loglik with late)
